summary: Antelope Enterprise Holdings Ltd (AEHL) filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, reporting that its board approved a 1-for-16 reverse stock split of its class A ordinary shares. The split becomes effective on August 7, 2026, and trading begins on a split-adjusted basis on Nasdaq on August 10, 2026, under the same ticker AEHL but with a new CUSIP. Outstanding shares will reduce from 20,947,145 to approximately 1,309,197. No fractional shares will be issued. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation. What to watch: potential Nasdaq compliance and post-split price stability.
